motivation: Static V4 and V4.1 generalized poorly across real months even though all governance and absolute-regret gates passed. The next method measures a bounded sample of legal candidates instead of retuning another static boundary.
source_status: The retained V4.1 final holdout is now exposed development data and can never again authorize an independent holdout claim.
governance_rules: Candidate feasibility is evaluated before any pilot execution.
A candidate rejected by the active policy cannot be piloted.
The pilot result cache must bind data snapshot, policy snapshot, query template, engine version, and optimizer version.
Pilot execution cost is reported and is never treated as free.
inconclusive_rule: Use the frozen 35 percent query-selectivity threshold; do not tune a new fallback from pilot answers.
failure_policy: Retain a failed result and stop this pilot design. Do not weaken the gates or alter the sample after opening pilot timings.
